name: deploy_mika
description: Deploy all mika binaries (mika, mika-spirit, mika-gateway) from build artifacts. Per-binary health check, backup/rollback, rc-service restart.

cwd.description: Path to the mika repo containing built artifacts at target/release/mika. Defaults to $MIKA_PLATFORM_DIR/mika.

task_id.description: Task UUID for dispatch-readiness validation. Required when called as a deploy hook within a milestone/sprint execution loop.
